text: Who is the toughest better of this generation to bowl to? There is only one answer AB Develace and I'll prove it with two innings. But before that if you are a true cricket fan you must follow this speech. January 2015 Johannesburg AB walks out against West Indies.

50 of 16 balls and 100 of 31 balls. Both still ODI world records. He finishes on 149 of just 44 balls. Now December, the same year, Delhi, south of Prikar, fighting to sever test. AB faces 297 balls for 43 runs.

Same man, same year, the fastest hundred in ODI SP and one of the most stubborn test innings you will ever see. That's the problem for ballers. You never knew which AB was walking out. Ball full, he drives you. Ball short, he pulls you. Ball wide, he walks across and scoops you over fine legs. Most bettors can either attack you or outlast you. AB could do both. That's why he's the toughest bettor of this generation. Agree or disagree? Tell me in the comments and follow for more stories like this.
